company.name: Robby Technologies
company.shortDescription: Robby Technologies is building self-driving robots to deliver food and packages autonomously to users' doorsteps.
company.description: Robby Technologies is building self-driving robots for last-mile delivery of food, groceries and packages. It was founded by two MIT PhDs in computer vision and robotics, selected into Y Combinator program in summer 2016, and featured by TechCrunch as one of the top startups. With the mission to make delivery affordable and convenient for everyone, Robby Technologies has partnered with customers globally including Fortune 500 companies.
